items.t: Automatic transmission slipping or failing
items.job: Replace automatic transmission with used or remanufactured unit
items.note: Owners report about $1,600 on average. A used transmission is the cheaper route on a car this age.

items.t: Crankshaft sensor connector can come loose and stall the engine (recall)
items.job: Replace crankshaft position sensor (recall 06V-266)
items.note: Free at a Toyota dealer if the recall is still open on your VIN.

items.t: Packed snow can damage the rear brake lines (recall)
items.job: Replace rear brake lines (recall 02V-268)

items.t: Weak power brake assist in cold weather (recall)
items.job: Replace brake booster and front pads (recall 01V-326)

items.t: Brake master cylinder seal can leak (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace master cylinder and booster as needed (recall 04V-455)

items.t: Frozen moisture at the brake vacuum port in winter (recall)
items.job: Modify intake brake vacuum port (recall 00V-256)

items.t: Check engine light from the EVAP system
items.job: EVAP smoke test and replace gas cap, hose or purge valve
items.note: RepairPal puts the diagnosis alone at about $122-$179. A gas cap is the cheapest fix; a charcoal canister costs more.

items.t: Sluggish acceleration from a dirty airflow sensor
items.job: Clean or replace mass airflow sensor
items.note: RepairPal estimates $173-$338 for replacement; cleaning costs much less.

items.t: Misfire from a failing ignition coil
items.job: Replace ignition coil(s) and spark plugs
items.note: Low end is one coil; high end is all four coils. RepairPal lists $548-$650 for the coil job.

items.t: Check engine light for misfire codes on early cars
items.job: Diagnose misfire codes and perform Toyota bulletin repair
items.note: Bulletin repairs on a car this old are normally paid by the owner.

items.t: Check engine light for variable valve timing (P1349)
items.job: Replace VVT oil control valve (timing chain if worn)
items.note: The valve is a short job. If the chain and sprockets are worn, labor rises to the high end.

items.t: Crankshaft sensor code (P0335) from a weak battery
items.job: Test and replace 12V battery

items.t: Check engine light for knock sensor (P0325)
items.job: Replace knock sensor

items.t: Check engine light for torque converter lockup (P0741)
items.job: Diagnose and replace lockup solenoid with fluid change
items.note: If the torque converter or transmission is worn inside, the cost moves toward a transmission replacement.

items.t: A/C compressor stops working
items.job: Replace A/C compressor, dryer and recharge

items.t: Weak heater and A/C fan or missing fan speeds
items.job: Replace blower motor resistor or blower motor

items.t: Manual transmission pops out of reverse
items.job: Adjust or repair shift linkage (internal repair if needed)
items.note: Linkage or mount repairs are the low end; opening the transmission is the high end.

items.t: Surface rust on the floor under the carpet
items.job: Pull carpet, treat rust and apply floor corrosion protection
items.note: Toyota's old service campaign (05020) supplied a protection kit; ask a dealer whether it still applies.

items.t: Water leaking into the cabin and musty smell
items.job: Water-leak test, reseal and dry carpet

items.t: Roof drip molding coming loose
items.job: Reattach or replace roof drip molding

items.t: Sagging headliner
items.job: Recover headliner board

items.t: Creak or tick from the windshield or rear glass
items.job: Inspect and service glass stoppers per Toyota bulletin

items.t: Exhaust flex pipe or muffler leak
items.job: Replace exhaust flex pipe or muffler

items.t: Clunking from worn control arms or bushings
items.job: Replace front lower control arm(s) and align

items.t: Humming or growling wheel bearing
items.job: Replace wheel bearing or hub assembly (one wheel)

items.t: Worn tie rod ends
items.job: Replace tie rod ends and align

items.t: Door latch not opening or locking properly
items.job: Replace door latch assembly
